file_insights.purpose: Add database indexes to optimize query performance on Batch, Bin, and ProductionOrder models
Add Meta class indexes definition to three models

patterns_discovered.description: All three models follow same indexing pattern: single indexes on 'status' and 'is_active' fields, with ProductionOrder including additional composite index on both fields
patterns_discovered.evidence: All models index on ['status'] and ['is_active'], suggesting these are common filter criteria

patterns_discovered.description: Changes made to both model Meta classes and corresponding migration file, ensuring schema consistency
patterns_discovered.evidence: ProductionOrder, Bin, and Batch all have matching index definitions in both models.py and migration file

patterns_discovered.description: ProductionOrder includes a composite index on ['status', 'is_active'] for queries filtering on both fields
patterns_discovered.evidence: Only ProductionOrder has 3 indexes while others have 2, indicating higher query complexity

patterns_discovered.description: Auto-generated index names follow Django pattern: 'app__field_hash_idx'

gotchas_discovered.description: Migration has dependencies on inventory and materials apps, requiring careful migration order during deployment
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Ensure inventory:0002_add_indexes and materials:0001_initial are applied before this migration

gotchas_discovered.description: Django truncates field names in index names (e.g., 'is_acti' instead of 'is_active'), which could make debugging harder but doesn't affect functionality
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Reference index names by their model definition rather than auto-generated names

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: No explicit validation of index selectivity
gotchas_discovered.description: Indexes on 'status' and 'is_active' may have low cardinality, reducing index effectiveness, but performance benefit requires data volume testing
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Monitor query performance post-deployment; consider index selectivity analysis if queries don't improve

gotchas_discovered.description: Adding indexes on production models requires careful planning, as this could lock tables during migration on large datasets
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Consider using CONCURRENTLY option or deploying during low-traffic windows

approach_outcome.description: Successfully created comprehensive database indexes for production app models
approach_outcome.completion: Both model definitions and migration file were properly created with consistent index strategy
deliverables: Updated model Meta classes with index definitions
approach_outcome.session_notes: First attempt succeeded; proper migration structure with correct dependencies and index configuration

recommendations.recommendation: After deployment, run EXPLAIN ANALYZE on queries filtering by status and is_active to verify index utilization
Monitor the composite index on ProductionOrder to ensure it's being used; consider evaluating if separate indexes are sufficient
Apply this migration during a maintenance window or low-traffic period to minimize production impact
Document the rationale for these specific indexes (status and is_active) to guide future index decisions
Consider creating a database indexing strategy document if not already present, to standardize approach across all apps
